title: CS40008: Parallel Algorithms
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Parallel Models (SIMD, MIMD, PRAMs, Interconnection Networks); Performance
Measures (Time, Processors, Space, Work); Interconnection Architectures (Linear
Array, Meshes, Trees, Mesh of Trees, Hypercubes, Butterfly Networks, Cube
Connected Cycles, Benes Networks); Techniques (Balanced Trees, Pointer Jumping,
Divide and Conquer, Partitioning, Pipelining, Systolic Computation, Accelerated
Cascading, Prefix Computation, List Ranking, Euler Tour, Tree Contraction);
Sorting, Searching, Merging; Matrix Operations; Graph Algorithms (Connected
Components, Spanning Trees, Shortest Paths); Complexity (Lower bounds, NC Class
and P-Completeness).
